entities.summary: Annet Nakawunde Mulindwa is a businesswoman and corporate executive in Uganda, the third-largest economy in the East African Community. She is the managing director and CEO of Finance Trust Bank, a financial service provider with assets valued at about US$92 million, as of 31 December 2020.
